what: The number counts down from start to end value (377 → 0) in proportion to how far the page is scrolled — the fixed bottom line’s ”(Altitude 377)” hits 0 at the very bottom, like a gauge descending the building

options.from: Value at the very top, default the number written in the number slot
options.to: Value at the very bottom, default 0
options.[data-fx-part=num]: Number-only swap spot (optional) — if absent, the whole element text is the number
options.track: if section, not the whole page but the attached section (nearest [data-fx-part=track], or the parent if none) counts while passing — 0 when the section top touches the screen top, 1 when the bottom touches the screen bottom
options.ease: If out, counts with an ease-out curve 1 − (1 − t)² that slows toward the end, default linear

from.where: shared.js bottom line (altitude 377) — scroll ratio × 377, rounded off, trims the line
shared.js .js-amount (top-right scroll progress — original main.js scroll amount: Math.round(min(position ÷ (document height − window height), 1) × 100), counting up from 0 to 100)
index.html .fd-transit (160vh hand-off between sections — original .transit: ScrollTrigger top top→bottom bottom, round(from + (to−from)·(1−(1−p)²)), data-km-from·to)
from.options: data-fx-scroll-countdown="from: 0; to: 400; track: section; ease: out"
